name: PdxColorPicker
description:
Colour selection from a swatch trigger or an inline panel, with alpha channel and preset palettes,
output as hex, rgb or hsl.

members.name: format
members.description: Output format: 'hex', 'rgb' or 'hsl'.

members.name: showAlpha
members.description: Shows the opacity (alpha) slider.

members.name: presets
members.description: Preset swatch colours.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Makes the value read-only — visible but not editable.

members.name: inline
members.description: Renders the picker inline instead of in a popover.

members.name: label
members.description: Visible label text.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows a clear button to reset the value.

members.name: size
members.description: sm, md (the default) or lg: the swatch's size.

members.name: value
members.description: The colour. A form submits it, and an empty entry when it is empty, as a text input does (#135).

members.name: show
members.description: Open the popup; open already, or inline, nothing changes.

members.name: close
members.description: Close the popup.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Open the popup when closed, close it when open.

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves focus to it.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from it.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the value.

members.name: getHex
members.description: The colour as `#rrggbb`, whatever the format.

members.name: getRgb
members.description: The colour as `{ r, g, b, a }`.

members.name: getHsl
members.description: The colour as `{ h, s, l, a }`.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The popup opened (`true`) or closed (`false`): its open state, read-only, as an overlay's (#287).

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Makes the value read-only — visible but not editable.

attributes.name: inline

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

attributes.name: size

attributes.name: value

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The swatch, the button that opens the popup; absent when `inline`.

cssParts.name: popup
cssParts.description: The panel: a floating `role="dialog"`, or in place when `inline`.

cssParts.name: area
cssParts.description: The colour area, a two-dimensional `role="slider"`: saturation and brightness.

cssParts.name: input
cssParts.description: The text field that reads and writes the colour.
